task.description:
Run the EE-03 test suite and produce a structured test report.

**Commands to run:**
```
zig build test
```

Verify that all EE-03 unit tests pass:
- tests/unit/test_tasks_store.zig
- tests/unit/test_engine_apply.zig
- tests/unit/test_tasks_api.zig

Also verify no previously-passing tests were broken by the EE-03 changes (`zig build test` must exit 0 across all test files).

**Write the test report to:** `tests/reports/EE-03-run-01.md`

Report format (per test_developer_guide.md §8):
- Run ID: WF02-ee03-20260522-run-01
- Date: (current)
- Tests executed: N
- Tests passed: N
- Tests failed: N
- Failures: list each failing test with: test name, expected, actual, file:line
- Overall result: PASS or FAIL

If all tests pass → result.status = "PASS".
If any test fails → result.status = "FAIL"; list all failures in result.issues.

Before completing, call `fn:validate-completeness` then `fn:register-inner-report`.
acceptance_criteria: All TC-EE-03-01 through TC-EE-03-08 executed and passed

result.summary: All EE-03 unit tests pass. zig build test exits 0 with 67 tests passing and 89 skipped (DB stubs). TC-EE-03-01 through TC-EE-03-05 verified via test_engine_apply.zig. TC-EE-03-API-01 through TC-EE-03-API-04 verified via test_tasks_api.zig. No regressions.
